title: Security Deposits Schedule of Commission Rate Selection for Refund-Date Interest
content:
For interest accrued to the refund date on a cash Security Deposits deposit, the commission rate is selected by how long the deposit has been held in full: the whole months from the paid-in-full date on the deposit record to the refund date.

## Schedule

| Whole months held in full before the refund date | Commission rate taken |
|---|---|
| 36 or more (the long held months) | the higher of the current year's and the previous year's commission rates |
| 18 to 35 (the short held months up to the long) | the average of the current year's and the previous year's commission rates |
| fewer than 18 | no other selection under this schedule |

A deposit paid in full at least **36** months before the refund date takes the higher of the current year's and the previous year's commission rates; one paid in full at least **18** but fewer than 36 months before it takes the average of those two rates.

## Commission rates (percent)

| Year | 2022 | 2023 | 2024 | 2025 | 2026 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Commission rate | 0.48 | 1.65 | 2.28 | 2.07 | 1.84 |

## Selections worked from the table

| Refund year | Current year's rate | Previous year's rate | Higher of the two | Average of the two |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2026 | 1.84 | 2.07 | 2.07 | 1.955 |
| 2025 | 2.07 | 2.28 | 2.28 | 2.175 |
| 2024 | 2.28 | 1.65 | 2.28 | 1.965 |

The average is used as it stands, without rounding the rate. At exactly 36 whole months the higher rate is taken; at exactly 18, the average.
